questions.question: Which language should the web app use?

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Recommended for a typed app and shared monorepo packages.

questions.question: Which TanStack frontend setup do you want?

options.label: React + TanStack Router
options.description: Use React with file-based TanStack Router.

options.label: React + TanStack Query
options.description: Use React and TanStack Query without adding TanStack Router.

questions.question: Should the existing SpeakTrack app be migrated into the TanStack web app, or kept as a separate vanilla Vite app?

options.label: Migrate SpeakTrack
options.description: Move the existing SpeakTrack experience into the new frontend.

options.label: Keep it separate
options.description: Preserve the current app and add a separate TanStack app to the monorepo.

questions.question: Which package manager should manage the monorepo? The current project has npm and a package-lock.json.

options.label: npm
options.description: Continue with the package manager already in use.

options.label: pnpm
options.description: Use pnpm workspaces for the monorepo.

options.label: Yarn
options.description: Use Yarn workspaces for the monorepo.

questions.question: Should the monorepo include a shared UI package for reusable components?

options.label: Yes
options.description: Create a package for UI components shared by apps.

options.label: No
options.description: Keep UI components inside the web app for now.

questions.question: Does the project need persistent data storage?

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: The current client-side app has no backend persistence.

questions.question: Will users sign in to use application features?

options.label: Yes
options.description: Users sign in to access application features.

options.label: No
options.description: The application does not require user sign-in.
